how: Every edit Joel gives goes in here the same turn, with his words and the strings the guide must (or must not) contain once it's done. Status pending until the guide has it; then applied.
tools/humanization/check_owner_edits.py checks every entry against GUIDE-SO-FAR.md; render_article_so_far.py runs it on every render.

His words of 2026-11-03 18:59 UTC are in experiments/t01-answers/JOEL-MESSAGE-20261103-1859.md; those of 22:04 and 22:05 UTC in experiments/t01-answers/JOEL-MESSAGE-20261103-2204.md; his round-2 answers of 2026-11-04 10:26 UTC in review/r02/ANSWERS-R02-20261104-1026.json.

entries.what: RP-4 his way: the hierarchy's last paragraph goes, his line stays in his words
entries.joel: 18:59: "rp-4 approve yes i want to keep the gut driven mental hell line altho i'd change it to sound more human: \"A gut-driven mental hell is often mistaken as shadow work\""
must_contain: A gut-driven mental hell is often mistaken as shadow work.
must_not_contain: A gut-driven mental hell is not automatically shadow work

entries.what: Q-1 (a): the Core Order's first step says to smell humic acid first
entries.joel: 18:59: "q-1 smell it first for sure, that's like an allergy test"
must_contain: Smell humic acid first; if that doesn't help, take a 5mg lick of it.
must_not_contain: Smell humic acid, take a 5mg lick of it.

entries.what: Q-4 (a): the lengths stay; Alone at 3 a.m. quotes the note as it is
Q-5 (a): room before body in all four places
must_contain: Then return to room, body, human, time, and love.

must_not_contain: Charcoal belongs only in the separate recent-oral-ingestion branch.
No entity, deity, demon, ancestor, angel, algorithm, mission, kundalini surge, or insight overrides basic safety.
